name: Retoa
source: A "Runefolk" (magical life form) who serves Justin Flamsteed. She possesses the title of "Green Rider" (緑の乗り手). Using magician technology (Magitech) she can ride a magic motorcycle and make long-range attacks with a gun.
translation: A "Runefolk" (magical life form) who serves Justin Flamsteed. She possesses the title of "Green Rider" (緑の乗り手). Using magician technology (Magitech) she can ride a magic motorcycle and make long-range attacks with a gun.
